description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductService interface, providing methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting Product entities using a JPA repository in a Spring application.

classes.name: ProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductService that interacts with the ProductRepository to perform CRUD operations on Product entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Product entity, setting its ID to null before saving through the repository.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Product entities from the repository.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Product by its ID, returning an Optional<Product>.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Product identified by ID with new data; throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the Product with the specified ID; throws ResourceNotFoundException if the product doesn't exist.
